question: What is the primary characteristic of a food fad?

options.A: It is a lifelong medical nutrition therapy prescribed by a doctor
options.B: It is a government-approved food distribution program for rural areas
options.C: It is a permanent WHO dietary guideline for community health
options.D: It is a short-lived enthusiasm for a specific diet or food

explanation: Food fads are defined by their temporary and intense popularity rather than long-term scientific validity. [learn more](GNS227_U2_T018#GNS227_U2_T018_h1)

question: Why do food fads spread so quickly among the general public?

options.A: They are always cheap and freely distributed by the government
options.B: They require a doctor's prescription before purchase
options.C: They are rigorously tested by hospital ethics committees first
options.D: They rely heavily on social media and peer recommendations

explanation: Modern communication channels and viral marketing drive the rapid adoption of trendy diets without scientific backing. [learn more](GNS227_U2_T018#GNS227_U2_T018_h1)

question: What emotional state often drives individuals to try extreme food fads?

options.A: Total indifference toward body weight and appearance
options.B: Frustration with slow results from normal lifestyle changes
options.C: Complete satisfaction with their current physical health status
options.D: Strict adherence to professional medical advice

explanation: People seek out fads when they want immediate solutions that conventional, steady lifestyle modifications do not provide quickly. [learn more](GNS227_U2_T018#GNS227_U2_T018_h2)

question: Which factor plays a major role in sustaining popularity for modern diet trends?

options.A: Long-term clinical trials published in medical journals
options.B: Social media influencers and peer group validation
options.C: Strict regulation by pharmaceutical manufacturing laws
options.D: Mandatory approval by the local nursing council

explanation: Digital platforms and community belonging heavily reinforce the daily use of trendy diets. [learn more](GNS227_U2_T018#GNS227_U2_T018_h2)

question: What is a defining feature of a single-food diet fad?

options.A: Eating a balanced mix of all basic food groups daily
options.B: Focusing almost entirely on one food item for rapid results
options.C: Consuming only hospital-approved liquid nutritional formulas
options.D: Following a strict meal plan designed by a registered dietitian

explanation: Single-food fads restrict intake to items like cabbage soup or citrus fruits, ignoring balanced nutrition principles. [learn more](GNS227_U2_T018#GNS227_U2_T018_h3)

question: Which claim is commonly associated with commercial detox teas?

options.A: Removing body toxins and resetting the metabolism
options.B: Lowering high blood pressure through electrolyte balance
options.C: Treating severe bacterial infections of the lower bowel
options.D: Permanently curing inherited genetic metabolic disorders

explanation: Detox products rely on false promises of cleansing the body, ignoring natural liver and kidney functions. [learn more](GNS227_U2_T018#GNS227_U2_T018_h3)

question: A patient on a strict elimination diet reports muscle weakness and fatigue. What is the most likely physiological cause?

options.A: Increased physical stamina from improved metabolic cleansing
options.B: Enhanced absorption of vitamins through the intestinal wall
options.C: Proper hydration levels maintaining normal electrolyte balance
options.D: Inadequate intake of essential nutrients and overall calories

explanation: Eliminating food groups deprives the body of vital macronutrients and micronutrients needed for normal cellular energy. [learn more](GNS227_U2_T018#GNS227_U2_T018_h4)

question: What dangerous complication can arise from using unverified herbal detox teas?

options.A: Electrolyte imbalances leading to heart rhythm problems
options.B: Total immunity against common gastrointestinal infections
options.C: Immediate increase in red blood cell production
options.D: Permanent strengthening of the cardiac muscle tissue

explanation: Excessive purging from harsh cleansers depletes essential minerals like potassium and sodium, threatening cardiac function. [learn more](GNS227_U2_T018#GNS227_U2_T018_h4)

question: Why are adolescents especially vulnerable to dangerous diet trends?

options.A: They experience body image pressures alongside high nutrient needs
options.B: They rarely consume processed foods or sugary beverages
options.C: They possess advanced knowledge of clinical nutritional science
options.D: They are completely immune to peer pressure on social media

explanation: Teens undergo rapid growth while navigating intense social pressures, making them prime targets for fad marketing. [learn more](GNS227_U2_T018#GNS227_U2_T018_h5)

question: A pregnant patient expresses interest in starting a severe weight-loss detox fad. What is the primary clinical concern?

options.A: It will cure gestational diabetes without the need for insulin
options.B: The diet will speed up the baby's growth beyond normal limits
options.C: Nutrient deprivation can harm both maternal and foetal development
options.D: Her body weight will remain completely unchanged throughout pregnancy

explanation: Pregnancy demands steady, balanced nutrition; restriction impairs foetal growth and maternal health. [learn more](GNS227_U2_T018#GNS227_U2_T018_h5)

question: How should a nurse best inquire about a patient's use of restrictive diets?

options.A: Ask open-ended questions about recent eating pattern changes without judgment
options.B: Ignore dietary habits and focus solely on vital sign measurements
options.C: Assume the patient eats a balanced diet based on their physical size
options.D: Scold the patient for believing unscientific internet rumors

explanation: Non-judgmental communication builds trust and encourages patients to share accurate health habits. [learn more](GNS227_U2_T018#GNS227_U2_T018_h6)

question: Which physical sign might indicate chronic malnutrition from a severe food fad?
explanation: Inadequate protein and essential fatty acid intake often manifests through visible changes in skin and hair integrity. [learn more](GNS227_U2_T018#GNS227_U2_T018_h6)

question: What is the most effective approach for a nurse counseling a patient on nutrition?

options.A: Encouraging the complete elimination of all carbohydrates
options.B: Promoting gradual, sustainable changes using affordable local foods
options.C: Recommending the most expensive imported fat-burning supplements
options.D: Insisting on immediate starvation to accelerate toxin elimination

explanation: Sustainable habits built on accessible local ingredients yield better long-term health outcomes than rigid fads. [learn more](GNS227_U2_T018#GNS227_U2_T018_h7)

question: Which question helps a patient identify a potential food fad?

options.A: Does this diet promise rapid weight loss by cutting out food groups?
options.B: Will this routine make me famous on the internet?
options.C: Is this meal plan approved by my favorite social media celebrity?
options.D: Can I buy these expensive pills at the local supermarket?

explanation: Promising fast results through extreme restriction is the hallmark of unreliable fad diets. [learn more](GNS227_U2_T018#GNS227_U2_T018_h7)
